maintenance_led.reason: Aftermarket services, spare parts, repair for installed pumps, valves and seals are roughly half or more of sales, per my recollection.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private energy, chemical and industrial companies buying pumps, valves and seals; some water and nuclear public work is minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through pumps, valves, seals and services sales, with only occasional acquisitions such as turbomachinery services.

mission_critical.reason: Engineered pumps, valves and seals are specified into critical plants, nuclear and process applications; switching needs requalification and risks downtime.

notes: Maintenance-led judgment relies on recalled aftermarket share, not stated in the website text.
